$comment: Optimus metrics the estate can measure itself (founder 2026-11-20: nothing ships without its Optimus metrics). A SHIP-CONTRACT may only name a metric registered here; Greenlane reads it by running `measure` from main, never from what an author says. A measure prints exactly `optimus.<name>=<number>` and needs no cluster or secret.

metrics.name: estate.platform_dirs_never_applied
metrics.description: platform/ kustomize directories that no Flux Kustomization applies (idp#8328)

metrics.name: admission.code_plus_test_refusals
metrics.description: admission rules that refuse a code change together with the test that proves it: 1 before idp#8649 (bin/verify_three_proofs.py proof 2 refused a platform/ change whose test lives in tests/), 0 after (the companion rides with the code, and two code subsystems, a guarded path without the founder seal and more than five files are still refused)

metrics.name: claims.ship_contract_enforced

metrics.name: estate.zone_a_graph_drain_files

metrics.name: legion.missions_landed
metrics.description: Conservative count of reachable main agent-sandbox (auto) landings joined by Greenlane-Head to a genuine Run receipt in the exact source commit (Git object or authenticated GitHub API); never a live inference or external effect claim (idp#8283/#8405)

metrics.name: greenlane.cross_main_failure_cap
metrics.description: Independent trusted-main execution of the actual Engine two-main unchanged-head identical-cause suppression, durable restart, changed-head re-admission, and UNKNOWN refusal (#8289); not a claim of external service availability

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_failures
metrics.description: Fatal R2 failure points in bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare's DNS/Workers critical path (I-8455 Stage 1: R2 gates only R2), counted as sites: the R2 mint path (fail mint "R2 token not created") plus every fatal 'fail r2' in the R2 bucket-proof path. Measured on main 2026-11-26 (dd4c1e8be): baseline 5 (1 mint + 4 bucket-proof), target 0 -- it reads 0 when I-8455 Stage 1 lands. The measure prints nothing and exits non-zero when it cannot judge the script, so the readback is UNKNOWN rather than a false 0 (idp#8575)

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_measure_reads
measure: import pathlib,re,subprocess; p=pathlib.Path('bin/optimus-r2-scoped-failures'); r=subprocess.run(['bash',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True); ok=bool(re.search(r'(?m)^optimus\.bootstrap\.r2_scoped_failures=-?\d+$',r.stdout or '')); print('optimus.bootstrap.r2_scoped_measure_reads=%d' % (1 if ok else 0))
metrics.description: 1 when the registered measure for bootstrap.r2_scoped_failures runs on main and prints a well-formed optimus.<name>=<number> line -- the readback is the deliverable, and a measure that cannot read is a metric that cannot fail (idp#8575); baseline 0, target 1

metrics.name: pr_age.red_runs_baseline_break
metrics.description: scheduled pr-age sweeps that exit BLIND/2 on a dead repo in the default --repos list (run 45595449643, idp#8537)

metrics.name: plan_lock.live_plan_refusals
measure:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "platform/estate/memory")
import plan as P

r = P.apply(None, "declare_plan", {"goal": "ship the feature", "subgoals": [{"id": "g1", "text": "first step"}]})
ok = bool(P.authorize("Edit", r.get("plan")).get("ok"))
print("optimus.plan_lock.live_plan_refusals=%d" % (0 if ok else 1))
metrics.description: ordinary tool calls the plan gate refuses after a plan is declared: 1 before idp#8558, 0 after (a declared plan is LIVE; the scenario is required before the goal is claimed done)

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_gate
measure: import pathlib; s=pathlib.Path('bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare').read_text() if pathlib.Path('bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare').exists() else ''; print('optimus.bootstrap.r2_scoped_gate=%d' % (1 if ('R2 gates only R2' in s and 'R2_SCOPE_FAILED' in s) else 0))
metrics.description: 1 when an R2 mint failure gates only R2: DNS and Workers always mint, verify and vault (I-8455 Stage 1, idp#8519); baseline 0, target 1

metrics.name: bootstrap.r2_scoped_warn_markers
measure: f=bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare; [ -f "$f" ] && grep -c 'R2 gates only R2' "$f" || echo 0
metrics.description: Scoped R2 WARN markers in bin/idp-bootstrap-cloudflare (I-8455 Stage 1, idp#8519); baseline 0, target >=4

metrics.name: gemini_outbox.verifier_falsifiers_declared
metrics.description: Number of #[test] falsifiers declared in the Gemini outbox verifier crate (platform/meridian-core-engines/crates/meridian-outbox-ingest): known-bad packets it must refuse (tampered or short bytes, proxy accept URL, target outside intake/, unsafe names, bad ids, wrong repo, duplicates) and known-good it must accept. metrics.name: friction.call_failure_rate_6h

metrics.name: friction.first_call_refused_rate_24h

metrics.name: friction.page_state
metrics.description: 0 OK, 1 TICKET, 2 PAGE for agent friction. SLO 10% failed calls: PAGE at 50% on both the 1h and 5m windows, TICKET at 20% on both the 6h and 30m windows. BLIND under 20 results in 6h, never 0.

metrics.name: friction.producer_falsifiers_passing

metrics.name: founder_action.falsifiers_declared

Counts declared tests, it does not run them; that they pass is proved by the Greenlane running tests/. 0 on main while the suite is absent.

metrics.name: founder_gate.falsifiers_passing
metrics.description: How many of 8 known-good and known-bad founder messages get the right verdict from bin/estate-founder-gate (proof line, one action, no secret, no filler, empty refused). 8 means every admission rule bites; less means a rule was weakened.

metrics.name: founder_gate.falsifiers_declared
metrics.description: Number of falsifier tests declared for the founder admission gate (tests/test_estate_founder_gate.py): a FAILED or ACTION message to the founder with no Exhausted receipt, an unresolved receipt, or a receipt replayed for another instruction is refused, and DONE is admitted without one. Counts declared tests, it does not run them; that they pass is proved by the Greenlane running tests/. 0 on main while the suite is absent.

metrics.name: plan_lock.installed_without_key
measure:
import importlib.machinery as M, importlib.util as U, pathlib
l = M.SourceFileLoader('inst', 'bin/estate-memory-install')
m = U.module_from_spec(U.spec_from_loader('inst', l)); l.exec_module(m)
root = pathlib.Path('/estate-home')
have = getattr(m, 'allow_rules', lambda r: [])(root)
want = ['mcp__' + m.MANIFEST['server'], 'Bash(%s/bin/estate-plan *)' % root]
print('optimus.plan_lock.installed_without_key=%d' % sum(w not in have for w in want))
metrics.description: of the two doors the plan lock's refusal sends an agent to (the estate-memory MCP plan tools, and the estate-plan shell fallback), how many the installer does NOT write into permissions.allow beside the lock: 2 before idp#8762, 0 after. Measured 2026-11-28: 55 of 523 Claude sessions in 3 days ended handing the turn to the founder on this deadlock.

metrics.name: agents_md.stop_directives
measure:
import pathlib, re
t = pathlib.Path('AGENTS.md').read_text()
pat = re.compile(r'(?i)\bthen stop\b|stop that action|may propose a change|contributes or waits|\bthen wait\b')
print('optimus.agents_md.stop_directives=%d' % len(pat.findall(t)))
metrics.description: instructions in the kernel AGENTS.md that tell an agent to stop, wait or only propose (founder, 2026-11-28: rules are enforced in code, not files; agents begin at full throttle and never stop). 1 before this change ("stop that action and verify the current authority"), 0 after.

metrics.name: greenlane.lane_preflight_before_floor
metrics.description: 1 when bin/lane-preflight, run on real git in a tmp repo, refuses a new Python file with no Language-Exception trailer (naming it), refuses a lane that does not merge onto origin/main, passes a clean lane, and .githooks/pre-push calls it BEFORE its disk-floor exit, so a machine short of disk is judged like any other. 0 on code where the preflight is missing, wired after the floor, or cannot run. The ruff-format rule needs the pinned formatter the judge may not carry and is proved by tests/test_lane_preflight.py.

metrics.name: consult_plane.proofs_passing
metrics.description: The number of executable proofs in the consultation plane that pass: 16 in tests/test_consult_plane.py (budget conservation, the local-browser transport ban, the Tier-0 digest cache, Class C injection quarantine, tier gating, blind challenger isolation, noise rejection, the asymmetric veto, founder-seal escalation and operational_yield enforcement) and 16 in tests/test_founder_firewall_and_poe.py (the AST discovery fallback, the three compulsory stuck triggers, zero-spend PoE rejection, the raw-dump cap, 3-strike reaping, cooldown demotion, spam, the four-class whitelist, the five-field card contract and the outage path). 0 before idp#8745; 32 with it.

metrics.name: thin_client.unguarded_worktree_spawn
metrics.description: 1 when any of git worktree add, git -C worktree add or git clone reaches git through the tracked shell door estate/gates/shell-guard.sh, 0 when the door refuses all of them. 1 on main (the door judged kills only), 0 with the zero-worktree judge wired in (#8725).

metrics.name: legion.launch_refusals_named
metrics.description: 1 when every launch refusal the executor can hand bin/legion-admit prints one fixed token naming its own class, 0 when a cause folds into one sentence or ends on a traceback instead of a refusal, and BLIND when the launcher cannot run here. Read on main with the shipped launcher: 0 at 8a003f777 (runs 46137092198 and 46137271107 both ended `REFUSED: provider admission invalid`), 1 with idp#8772.

metrics.name: greenlane.receipt_404_per_tick
metrics.description: Receipts in one simulated Greenlane tick whose post lands on an address GitHub's REST router answers with 404, measured by driving the shipped report_operational with a stand-in for `gh api`: 10 at bdab1b43a (run 46137784537 logged ten 404s at repos//issues//comments and repos/chidionyema/issues/idp/<n>), 0 with idp#8773.

metrics.name: estate.discovery_contradictions
metrics.description: Resources in catalog/estate-resources.json whose probe answered the opposite of the declared status, read by driving the shipped bin/estate-discovery over the whole ledger (11 resources, 0 contradictions measured 2026-11-28). A probe that cannot run on the host is counted apart and printed on stderr, so a laptop and a runner give the same reading (idp#8746).

metrics.name: greenlane.claim_lapsed_while_held
metrics.description: Minutes of a three-hour lane hold in which the claim sat past bin/claim-gate's own MAX_AGE, read by driving the shipped Engine._heartbeat_lanes and GitHubBackend.heartbeat once per simulated minute (only the clock is faked). 117 measured on main dcb7b68df7 (45-50 min cadence under a comment claiming a 2h limit), 0 on the lane that mirrors the gate's lapse (idp#8742).

metrics.name: state_page.unknown_rendered
metrics.description: 1 when bin/estate-state-page renders an unreadable claim ledger as UNKNOWN instead of a measured zero (idp#8781), 0 when it renders '0 of 0' or crashes
